article: 15 recommended books for beginning software engineers
scope: Read and compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations. Checked that all fifteen entries remain represented; repaired the missing/duplicated list number, restored the historical publication date and set review lastmod, checked the three localized internal article links, and checked image references and translated alt text.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date (2026-09-24) from all 13 files; restored the repository's original publication date (2024-05-05) and recorded the review date as lastmod.
Fixed the broken nested Docker Markdown URL and checked the Docker, Kubernetes, and object-oriented programming links point to the corresponding language editions.
Corrected the list numbering from 1–5, 7, 7 to 1–15.
Changed misleading .png alt labels to localized book-cover descriptions and retained the actual .webp image files.
